sections.title: Stamp Stands
sections.note: 25 stands, never in caves, buildings or underwater. No official numbering; grouped by region. Available after the Suthorn Ruins.

items.name: Hyrule Ranch gate
items.howTo: Just outside the ranch's front gate, southwest of Hyrule Castle.

items.name: Far west of Kakariko
items.howTo: Far west of Kakariko Village, on a plateau/cliff beside a cave entrance.

items.name: Kakariko Village entrance
items.howTo: Right by the entrance to Kakariko Village.

items.name: Eastern Temple approach
items.howTo: East of the town, at the entrance to the ruins that lead to the Eastern Temple (base of the stairs).

items.name: River island south of Hebra
items.howTo: On a small grassy island in the river/lake south of Hebra Mountain, northeast of Castle Town.

items.name: Lake Hylia southeast
items.howTo: Secluded spot at the southeast end of Lake Hylia, southeast of the Great Fairy Shrine; reachable from the southern path of Suthorn Forest.

items.name: Southeast Gerudo Desert
items.howTo: On a raised ledge/cliff southeast of the Oasis, just east of the large rift site (Gerudo Sanctum).

items.name: Northwest of the Oasis
items.howTo: Between two red stone pillars just northwest of the Oasis, where the red Lanmola appears.

items.name: West of Gerudo Town
items.howTo: On the high cliff just west of Gerudo Town; climb the ledge south of town and go west and north.

items.name: Far northwest Gerudo Desert
items.howTo: Far north of Gerudo Town up the high cliffs, beside the northern rift and southeast of a cave; Game8 says it can be reached from Hyrule Field.

items.name: Seesyde Village
items.howTo: Beside the ramp at the village's north entrance, next to two people talking.

items.name: Zora Cove east islet
items.howTo: Small piece of land at the far east/southeast edge of Zora Cove, east of Sea Zora Village.

items.name: West of Jabu-Jabu's Den
items.howTo: In the lake west of Lord Jabu-Jabu's Den, south of River Zora Village (southwest of the big rift).

items.name: Above River Zora Village
items.howTo: High ledge northwest of River Zora Village, at the lake above the waterfalls; stack Echoes (e.g. Water Block) to climb.

items.name: Below Goron City
items.howTo: Next to the small hot spring at the foot of the stairs/ramp up to Goron City, southeast of the entrance.

items.name: Lava island
items.howTo: On a small platform in the lava lake south of the Rock-Roast Quarry entrance.

items.name: Eldin Volcano summit
items.howTo: Highest platform near the lava fall in northwest Eldin Volcano; fly up the cliffs (Game8 suggests the Techtite Automaton).
items.notes: Nintendo Life: reachable after the Eldin Temple.

items.name: Far east of Eldin Volcano
items.area: Eastern edge of Eldin Volcano (above the Eternal Forest)
items.howTo: Ride the updraft at the eastern edge with a flying Echo (Peahat/Mothula) and glide down to the stand on the low ledge below.

items.name: Hebra Mountain entrance
items.area: Hebra Mountain (exit of the Hebra Mountain Passage)
items.howTo: Just south of where you exit the cave onto Hebra Mountain.

items.name: Northeast of Condé's House
items.howTo: High up behind trees northeast of Condé's House, west of the Moblin camp; melt the small ice crystal on the ledge.

items.name: Swallowed stand (north Hebra)
items.howTo: Past the rolling snowballs east of the cave to the peak, at the small rift with the Stamp Guy; complete 'Stamp Stand Swallowed!'.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon: after the Hyrule Castle dungeon.

items.name: Northeast Faron pond
items.howTo: In the middle of the pond on top of the waterfall in the far northeast corner; climb the cliff.

items.name: Scrubton south waterfall
items.howTo: Right side of Scrubton's southern exit, on a small lake atop a waterfall south of the Deku Scrub Lockup.

items.name: North of Heart Lake
items.howTo: On a high ledge next to trees north/northeast of Heart Lake in the southwest Faron Wetlands; climb over with a Crawltula.

items.name: Ledge by the Hidden Ruins
items.howTo: South of Scrubton by the two tall torches, on a ledge behind the Hidden Ruins entrance (northwest of the Stilled Blossu's House rift).

sections.title: Stamp card rewards
sections.note: The Stamp Guy parachutes in each time a card of 5 is filled.

items.name: First Stamp Card filled
items.howTo: Collect 5 stamps.

items.name: Exciting Stamp Card filled
items.howTo: Collect 10 stamps.

items.name: Thrilling Stamp Card filled
items.howTo: Collect 15 stamps.

items.name: Exhilarating Stamp Card filled
items.howTo: Collect 20 stamps.

items.name: Final Stamp Card filled
items.howTo: Collect 25 stamps.
